title: Nang cap GHI CHU MTEXT: In hoa tieu de nhom, doi ten nut, don gian hoa prompt chi hoi chieu cao chu, xuat MText layer T_TEXT 0.18mm
scope: Doi tieu de nhom tren Palette tu 'Trien khai va thong ke' thanh in hoa: 'TRIEN KHAI VA THONG KE'
Doi ten nut 'VIET CHU' thanh 'GHI CHU MTEXT' (RoundButton textWrite110)
Dieu chinh lenh T-VIETCHU / TextWrite110: Khong hoi nhieu thiet lap phuc tap, CHI HOI DUY NHAT chieu cao chu (co nho gia tri lan truoc)
Mac dinh Layer la T_TEXT, Lineweight 0.18 mm, Color 7 (Trang), Text Style Tuan_arial (Arial.ttf)
Doi tuong xuat ra phai la MText (Multiline Text), khong dung DBText
Cap nhat ban cai dat moi TVXD.BG V11 tai D:\TuanPa_AI\OUTPUT\11. TVXD.BG V11 va D:\OneDrive\TuanPa_AI\OUTPUT\11. TVXD.BG V11
out_of_scope: Cac tinh nang khac cua module MEPS
acceptance_criteria: Tieu de tren Palette hien thi dung chu in hoa 'TRIEN KHAI VA THONG KE'
Nut bam hien thi dung ten moi 'GHI CHU MTEXT'
Khi goi lenh T-VIETCHU / click nut tren Palette: chi hoi duy nhat Chieu cao chu, enter la chon diem chen va go chu
Doi tuong sinh ra tren AutoCAD la AcDbMText thuoc Layer T_TEXT, net 0.18, mau 7
Bien dich thanh cong qua build_v4.cmd ra TVXD.Meps.Merged.dll
Dong goi ban V11 tai D:\TuanPa_AI\OUTPUT\11. TVXD.BG V11 khop 100% SHA256SUMS.json
